article.title: MCI USA推Jade，將活動報名、住宿與展商跟進串連
article.summary: MCI USA推出Jade，透過其管理服務連接活動報名、住宿及展商商機管理。
highlights: 主辦方可查閱已報名與已訂房的情況。
參展商可掃描名牌、記錄會談及協助評估商機。
article.why: 活動團隊可把出席、酒店預訂與展後跟進分開量度。
article.next_step: 以一場活動檢查報名和住宿資料能否對應，再抽查展商的會談記錄。
article.detail: MCI USA表示，Jade可連接活動報名和酒店資料，協助服務團隊查閱房間供應及已報名未訂房的情況。展商可掃描名牌並使用輔助筆記和商機評估功能。工具現階段透過MCI USA服務提供，活動團隊可先確認資料由誰管理、誰可查看，以及展後如何跟進。
article.title_en: MCI USA launches Jade to link event registration, housing and exhibitor follow-up
article.summary_en: MCI USA introduced Jade through its managed services, linking registration, housing and exhibitor leads.
highlights_en: Organisers can check registration and hotel booking status.
Exhibitors can scan badges, capture notes and use assisted lead scoring.
article.why_en: Event teams can measure attendance, hotel bookings and post-show follow-up separately.
article.next_step_en: Check whether registration and housing records match, then sample exhibitor meeting notes.
article.detail_en: MCI USA says Jade connects registrations and hotel information so service teams can see room inventory and registered attendees without reservations. Exhibitors can scan badges and use assisted notes and lead scoring. Jade is offered through MCI USA services. Event teams can check who owns the data, who can view it and how leads move into follow-up.
